claims.text: European cSCC guideline: nicotinamide 500 mg twice daily may be offered to immunocompetent pts w multiple prior cSCCs
claims.quote: the European consensus-based interdisciplinary guideline for invasive cutaneous SCC stated that nicotinamide 500 mg twice daily may be offered to immunocompetent patients with a history of multiple cutaneous SCCs
claims.locator: Chemoprevention in Skin Cancer: What Advice? (Cancers (Basel), 2026)
